Creating a realistic 3 year growth plan for Julie who is a cooking creator with 1.2 million followers, she focuses on quick, healthy recipes. 

Her goals are to grow her online audience and publish a cookbook within 3 years. compare traditional publishing with self publishing and recommend best option for her. 

Break plan into year 1, 2 and 3 with specific actions, milestones, estimated costs, revenue opportunities and measurable goals. keep in mind Julie works 4 days per week on a limited budget.
